stars.headline: JAXA launches the Martian Moons eXploration spacecraft from the Tanegashima Space Center toward Phobos aboard…
stars.summary: JAXA launched the Martian Moons eXploration spacecraft on an H3 rocket toward Phobos, aiming to collect surface material and return it to Earth in 2031.

stars.headline: Russia's Fobos-Grunt mission to the Martian moon of Phobos runs into problems shortly after its launch, with…
stars.summary: Russia’s Fobos‑Grunt mission to Phobos encountered problems shortly after launch, with no telemetry received from the spacecraft.

stars.headline: Russia's unmanned Fobos-Grunt space probe re-enters the Earth's atmosphere after a failed mission to the…
stars.summary: Russia’s unmanned Fobos‑Grunt probe re‑entered Earth’s atmosphere and disintegrated over the southern Pacific Ocean after a failed mission to Phobos; China’s Yinghuo‑1, launched with it, was also destroyed.

stars.headline: NASA awards Lockheed Martin a contract to build a next-generation "Mars Ascent Vehicle" to return the first…
stars.summary: NASA awarded Lockheed Martin a contract to build a next‑generation Mars Ascent Vehicle that will return the first rock samples from Mars to Earth in the 2030s.

stars.headline: A pinch of fine sand and dust became the first solid Martian sample deposited into the Sample Analysis at…
stars.summary: A small amount of fine sand and dust from the Rocknest area was the first solid Martian sample deposited into the Sample Analysis at Mars instrument on Curiosity.

stars.headline: NASA selects Jezero crater on Mars as the landing site for the Mars 2020 rover
stars.summary: NASA selected Jezero crater on Mars as the landing site for the Mars 2020 rover, a crater that once held a large lake and may contain evidence of ancient life.
